examples: pm convertkit broadcasts list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create broadcast reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit create broadcast apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a draft or scheduled email broadcast; a scheduled broadcast (send_at/published_at set) will send to the account's live subscriber list, external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create custom field reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit create custom field apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new custom subscriber field on the account (up to 140 total); low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create purchase reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit create purchase apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: records a new purchase-tracking transaction for a subscriber; external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit create tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new tag on the account; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit create webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a webhook that POSTs subscriber-event payloads to an external URL the caller controls; external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Run the custom fields ETL stream
examples: pm convertkit custom fields list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete broadcast reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit delete broadcast apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a draft or scheduled broadcast record; irreversible, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit delete webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a webhook automation; irreversible, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm convertkit forms list --json
pm convertkit purchases list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the remove tag from subscriber reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit remove tag from subscriber apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes a tag from a subscriber; external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm convertkit sequences list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the subscribe to form reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit subscribe to form apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: subscribes an email address to a form (creating the subscriber if the email is new); external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the subscribe to sequence reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit subscribe to sequence apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: subscribes an email address to a sequence (creating the subscriber if the email is new); external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm convertkit subscribers list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the tag subscriber reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit tag subscriber apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: applies a tag to a subscriber (creating the subscriber if the email is new); external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm convertkit tags list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update broadcast reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit update broadcast apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates a draft or scheduled broadcast's content/send time; external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update custom field reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit update custom field apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames a custom field's label (the underlying key is unchanged per Kit's own docs); external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update subscriber reverse-ETL action
examples: pm convertkit update subscriber apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing subscriber's name/email/custom-field values; external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
